# Security Checklist: Snack Rich Formatting (Sanitization & Whitelist)

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of the *sanitization and whitelist requirements* for snack rich formatting — not the implementation. This is a "unit test for the requirements" for the security boundary (US3, FR-015–FR-019, FR-024).
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) — sections §Requirements (Security/sanitization), §User Story 3, §Edge Cases, §Success Criteria

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.checklist`. Items test whether the requirements are well-written, complete, and verifiable — they are not runtime test cases.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact set of permitted constructs (bold, paragraphs, bullet lists) enumerated as a closed whitelist, with everything else explicitly out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §Non-Goals]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every listed injection payload class (`<script>`, `onerror`, `javascript:` URLs, `<iframe>`, `<img>`, `<style>`, inline styles)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified that sanitization is applied at render time (defense in depth) rather than only at generation or storage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK004 Is the requirement that readable text must survive neutralization documented for all non-whitelisted markup? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK005 Is the history view explicitly included in the sanitization guarantee, rather than implied? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for non-whitelisted markup other than scripts (links, images, headings, tables, code, iframes, inline styles)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "neutralized" defined with a specific outcome (stripped or rendered as inert text) rather than left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019] — **Resolved**: FR-015 now mandates rendering as inert, escaped text (never executed, injected, or silently dropped).
- [x] CHK008 Is the allowed output vocabulary quantified precisely enough to distinguish "whitelisted" from "arbitrary HTML"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK009 Is "sanitization at the render boundary" unambiguous about which layer owns it (frontend render path, not backend)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is the requirement "not executed or injected into the DOM" stated with a verifiable meaning (no execution and no injected nodes)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §SC-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the sanitization requirements align with the backend-preserves-text-unmodified assumption, with no contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-017, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Are the whitelist requirements consistent between the snack card, results recap, and history view? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-023, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK013 Does the "no full Markdown/HTML dialect" non-goal conflict with any rendering requirement? [Consistency, Spec §Non-Goals, §FR-015]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can "0 executable or unsanitized markup reaches the DOM" be objectively measured across all surfaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK015 Is the security test set that must produce zero executions explicitly identified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK016 Can "readable text is not silently lost" be objectively verified for each payload class? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for malformed/half-open markup reaching the renderer (e.g. unclosed `**`)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for escaped entities in stored text (`&lt;`, `&amp;`) without double-escaping? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is the behavior specified when a snack field is empty or whitespace-only? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for non-whitelisted markup in the history view specifically (not just the snack card)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK021 Is there a requirement covering mixed content (paragraph + list + paragraph) with non-whitelisted markup interspersed? [Coverage, Gap] — **Resolved**: added an explicit mixed-content-with-non-whitelisted-markup edge case to Spec §Edge Cases.

## Non-Functional & Boundary

- [x] CHK022 Is the trust boundary (untrusted model output) explicitly identified and documented? [Traceability, Spec §Context, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK023 Is the requirement that no raw HTML is bound without sanitization stated as a hard constraint (FR-018) and is it traceable to the chosen approach? [Traceability, Spec §FR-018, research.md R1]
- [x] CHK024 Are performance implications of render-time sanitization addressed or explicitly deemed negligible? [Coverage, Gap, plan.md §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK025 Is the assumption that the backend will not sanitize validated and its risk (future `@PrePersist` trimming) documented? [Assumption, research.md R3]

## Dependencies & Ambiguities

- [x] CHK026 Is the sanitization requirement independent of any third-party sanitizer dependency, and is that constraint stated? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, research.md R1]
- [x] CHK027 Is it clear whether neutralization means "strip" or "show as inert text" where both are listed, and does the spec pick one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019] — **Resolved**: FR-015 and contracts/snack-text-format.md now consistently pick "inert, escaped text".
- [x] CHK028 Is the term "whitelisted formatting" given a single authoritative definition referenced by all FRs? [Ambiguity, Spec §Key Entities]
